CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 08 / 12

Production and cost curves

Cost curve relationships成本線關係

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Read and draw the typical curves: AFC falls with output; MC crosses AVC and ATC at their minima; MC below an average pulls it down and MC above it pulls it up.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

固定成本分攤更多產量令 AFC 下降；MC 低於平均值會拉低平均，高於平均值會拉高平均。因此 MC 在 AVC、ATC 各自最低點相交。

AFC falls as a fixed sum is spread across output. When MC is below an average it pulls that average down; above it, the average rises. Thus MC crosses AVC and ATC at their respective minima for smooth typical curves.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Current ATC=10; the next unit costs 6. Adding a below-average unit lowers ATC. 下一件較便宜會拉低平均。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

At a given output MC<ATC. What is ATC doing locally? 平均總成本如何變？
